name: Natsume Sasa
source:
Loves her sister’s husband. Masayuki, who works hard, but gets awkward around women, is just so cute to her, she wants to make him hers. 
They met when Mayuka brought Masayuki home once. This all started then, when Sasa fell in love at first sight. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=138]MangaGamer[/url]]
